en: Two-sided postcard. Front: a color photograph of the famous exterior fresco 'The Last Judgment' covering the west façade of Voroneț Monastery's church, with rows of saints, angels and Paradise scenes painted on the blue background under the eaves. Back: Romanian layout with "CARTE POȘTALĂ," address lines, a stamp box, a printed multilingual caption identifying Voroneț Church and the subject of the fresco, and a blue circular price mark of 2 lei.
